{"decision": "pass", "reason": "这是一个通用的心情记录网页工具，页面只有日历、五档心情选择和本地存储、导出等常规功能，没有看到特别的切入角度、垂直场景或巧妙的创意，也没有值得学习的独特做法。"}

verdict.reasoning: The reason cites a calendar, a five-level mood picker, local browser storage and JSON/CSV export, all of which appear on the page, and it makes no unsupported claims. Those are concrete features of this post, and calling them generic with no unique angle supports the pass decision.
